name: Hayward (United States)
description: Vertically divided white and red, the white half charged with a red rectangle bordered in white and blue: the international code flags H for Hayward and W for Wisconsin.
history: Hayward is a city in Sawyer County, Wisconsin, and its county seat. The flag was adopted on 14 June 2016 (the Hayward Centennial Flag, adopted by the city council on Flag Day, 14 June 2016, according to Flags of the World citing the Sawyer County Record).

features.role: signal flag W, a red rectangle bordered in white and blue
